summary.text: Bill Gannon is a Republican state senator and attorney from New Hampshire who has represented District 23 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as William Gannon, notes earlier service in the State Senate from 2016 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: William Gannon earned a B.A. from Saint Anselm College and a J.D. from Massachusetts School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and owning a business.
Gannon served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 4 from 2014 to 2016 and in the State Senate for District 23 from 2016 to 2018, returning to the Senate in 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee and serves on the Senate Executive Departments and Administration Committee.
